title: A Kit Lens Photo Just Filled a 35-Foot Billboard
excerpt: A candid frame of a grandmother drinking coffee, shot on a crop-sensor camera with the kit lens, now fills a 35-foot billboard at Frankfurt Airport. The gear debate has an answer, and it is not the one the spec sheets give.

title: Your Phone Is Editing Your Memories Before You See Them
excerpt: More than half of UK adults say their smartphone photos look nothing like the scene they remember, and nearly half only notice when the moment is gone. The camera that decides for you is a camera you do not control.

title: Polaroid 600 Film Is Better Than You Think, and It Teaches Exposure
excerpt: Polaroid 600 film was declared dead in 2008. Eighteen years later the current generation is sharper, more consistent, and more honest than the film that earned it a bad name, and every frame still teaches you to slow down and look.
